newsitem.title: USA: Fund flows jump for 3 days ended Nov 7 - survey.
newsitem.headline: Fund flows jump for 3 days ended Nov 7 - survey.

text.p: Flows into stock mutual funds jumped dramatically to $2.22 billion for the three-day period ended Nov 7, compared with $443 million for the two days ended Nov 4, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
U.S. stock funds had inflows of $1.83 billion compared with $280 million, while international funds had inflows of $386 million versus $163 million.

Aggressive growth stock funds had inflows of $678 million versus $32 million, growth funds had inflows of $688 million versus $67 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $513 million versus $215 million.
Bond funds had outflows of $77 million compared with inflows of $706 million.
Among bond funds, government/GNMA had outflows of $59 millin versus inflows of $172 million, whle muni funds had outflows of $206 million versus inflows of $285 million.
